messages:
lina: Heads-up — after today's private-controlplane deploy, a few onprem admin flows are returning 403 when routed through the VPC proxy. Not all admins, appears tenant-scoped.
raj: Which admin actions are failing? any error text we can share?
elena: Seeing similar from a support ticket earlier: '403 admin:insufficient_scope'.
lina: Example from curl to controlplane via proxy:
```
HTTP/1.1 403 Forbidden
content-type: application/json
{
  "error": "admin:insufficient_scope",
  "message": "actor lacks tenant:write on tenant/bluebox",
  "audit_id": "a12f9"
}
```
elena: quick debug: proxy attaches x-forwarded-for + x-proxy-id, but I noticed we dropped x-actor-role header in the multi-tenant path. That header is used for role-mapping in private-controlplane.
samir: If proxy strips actor role, controlplane treats request as svc-account (least privilege) — explains the 403s.
kelly: Does this affect Dedicated as well or only Private deployments behind that proxy?
lina: Only Private so far — dedicated routes skip the proxy. Impact is limited but customer-facing.
raj: Immediate mitigations?
ops-bot: deploy-bot: canary rollback scheduled -> v2026.3.1 -> target=10% -> started
samir: Short term: we can add a proxy rule to forward x-actor-role for requests with x-tenant header. Quick config patch. Also create a temporary role-binding for the proxy's service account to allow tenant:write while we patch.
elena: I'll open a PR for the forward-header patch and add unit tests for header passthrough. Patch diff snippet:
```
- headers.drop('x-actor-role')
+ headers.keep('x-actor-role')
```
kelly: Security checklist: rotate any ephemeral admin tokens that passed through the proxy during window, export audit logs for the window, and check KMS unwrap events for suspicious activity.
raj: Good call — lina, can you export audit logs for a 30m window starting at 3071239900 and share KMS unwraps? We need to confirm no sensitive ops succeeded while scope was missing.
lina: On it. Running export now: `rbx-logs export --from 3071239900 --to 3071240100 --filter "admin:insufficient_scope" --out /tmp/forensics.json`
ops-bot: alert-bot: customer-notify-template queued for impacted tenants (draft ready) :eyes:
samir: After hotfix, we should add an automated test asserting proxy preserves actor headers for both passthrough and multi-tenant routes.
elena: Also add an e2e that simulates an onprem admin using the proxy and validates audit entries include actor and role.
kelly: Create an incident page, assign Sev3, stakeholders: infra, sec, support. I'll start the incident doc.
lina: Hotfix timeline: PR -> quick canary -> rollback if anything odd. I estimate 30-45m to PR+canary. Will post updates here.
raj: After hotfix, follow-up tasks: (1) postmortem w/ root cause, (2) retro on deploy gating for proxy changes, (3) ensure KMS audit retention covers 90d for onprem incidents.
lina: update: PR opened #4983, canary started, first 10% traffic looks good. No new 403s in canary logs.
ops-bot: deploy-bot: canary -> promote to 50% -> started
kelly: Thanks all. Please paste the audit export link when ready and add any affected tenant IDs to the incident doc.
lina: Audit export uploaded to s3://rbx-forensics/3071239999/forensics.json
samir: Confirmed no KMS unwrap anomalies in that window.
elena: I'll follow up with tests + CI gate for next week.
raj: Closing loop: add a runtime metric alarm for actor-header-missing rate > 0.1% so we catch regressions.
lina: added metric+alert. Marking thread for follow-up in postmortem.
kelly: :thumbsup: thanks team.
